From legal text to
board-level action.

This is the five-minute story: ingest a real document, compile evidence-linked duties, expose policy gaps, trace regulatory change, and preserve every human decision.

Live benchmark—executed, not hard-coded
01 / ACQUIRE

Bring your own regulation

Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown. RegulaTrace extracts selectable text locally and reports document statistics before analysis.

02 / COMPILE

Make every duty inspectable

Each obligation carries an actor, action, modality, deadline, condition, exception, source identity, version, evidence span, confidence, and review state.

03 / DECIDE

Turn change into work

Constraint-aware policy comparison catches deadline and polarity failures. Change Radar converts legal edits into a prioritized impact queue.

WHY THIS IS PAPER-WORTHY

A falsifiable system, not a scripted prototype.

  • Executable evaluationEvery metric is produced by a transparent challenge suite.
  • Human-centered evidenceDecisions persist with reviewer, timestamp, record, and note.
  • Reproducible baselineThe deterministic engine is a measurable lower bound for future Legal-BERT or LLM experiments.
  • One-server reliabilityFastAPI serves the interface, API documentation, storage, and analysis together.

FROM CAPSTONE TO PUBLICATION

A paper-shaped project
from day one.

RegulaTrace is organized around falsifiable claims, baselines, ablations, held-out documents and a human-centered evaluation—not a one-off demo.

PRIMARY RESEARCH QUESTION

Can an evidence-first hybrid pipeline produce more complete, reviewable and change-aware obligation records than lexical rules or an unconstrained language model—while reducing analyst effort without increasing critical misses?

H1 · higher field F1H2 · lower critical missesH3 · faster review
CONTRIBUTION 01

Atomic obligation representation

A typed intermediate representation combining normative meaning, temporal anchors, exceptions, provenance and review state.

CONTRIBUTION 02

Constraint-aware policy alignment

A staged method that retrieves broadly but compares actor, action, polarity, timing, scope and exceptions separately.

CONTRIBUTION 03

Graph-based revision impact

A structure-aware change detector that turns legal edits into a queue of affected obligations, controls and owners.

14

Weeks to a defensible result

Each gate ends with evidence—not an assertion.
